decisions.decision: Classes are English AND AI — dual mission
Confidence first, English second — first 3 months focus on comfort zone expansion
Follow-up questions as core skill for shy/introvert students
App must replicate natural conversation pattern from live classes
4 fun consequences system for phone rule violations (TikTok/karaoke/presentation/joke — 30s each)
Ken (Quyen Ngo) confirmed as assistant teacher for beginner class
Updated Telegram seed distribution workflow — post updated seed, students delete old one

new_principles.interpretation: The product is not just English teaching. AI literacy is equal or greater priority for student career outcomes.
First 3 months: build comfort zone, relationships, and relaxation. English skill comes after the foundation of psychological safety.

new_principles.verbatim: Listen for what you know, not what you don't
new_principles.interpretation: Counter the Vietnamese learner habit of fixating on unknown words. Train pattern recognition on familiar structures.

new_principles.verbatim: Questions are the shy person's superpower
new_principles.interpretation: Introverts can control conversations and build connections through follow-up questions without needing advanced English.
Rest and balance are prerequisites for sustained performance. Overwork without recovery breaks the tool.

emotional_signal.notes: High energy / excitement when discussing app progress: 'live testing went well', 'first connection to our server last night'. Passionate conviction on AI + English dual mission. Genuine care for student wellbeing.

system_design_insights: Natural conversation replication — The app's core value proposition is replicating the organic conversation flow from live classes. The transcripts ARE the training data for what the app should feel like.
AI as co-teacher pattern — Gemini was used as real-time translator/assistant despite limitations. The OBI app should do this better.
Student profiling from transcripts — Rich personality, learning style, and progress data extractable from classroom transcripts.
Ken as force multiplier — Assistant teacher model works. Ken handles warm-up/practice while Michael takes breaks.
